# Carte

```{r}
coord <- data.frame(site = c("Lomergat", "Rozegat"),
                    latitude = c("48 17.234", "48 19.156"),
                    longitude = c("-4 21.179", "-4 23.051")) %>% 
  mutate(latitude = conv_unit(.$latitude, from = "deg_dec_min", to = "dec_deg"),
         longitude = conv_unit(.$longitude, from = "deg_dec_min", to = "dec_deg")) %>% 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(coords, crs = 3857)

#polygone bretagne
eu_sig <- st_read("data/FRA_adm_shp/FRA_adm0.shp")

brit2 <- st_crop(eu_sig, y = c(xmin = -4.6, xmax = -4.2, ymin = 48.2, ymax =48.4))
brit2<- st_transform(brit2, crs = 3857)
#donnee brute ofb
ofb_data <- read_sf("data/export_maj-4/maj.shp")
ofb_data <- st_make_valid(ofb_data)
brit_buffer <- st_buffer(brit2, 10000)

subset.int<-st_intersects(ofb_data, brit_buffer)
subset.int.log <- lengths(subset.int) > 0
brittany_only <- filter(ofb_data, subset.int.log)

#buffer de 200m autour de chaque polygone
buff_200 <- sf::st_buffer(brittany_only, 200)
buff200_units <- buff_200 %>% 
  st_union %>% 
  st_cast('POLYGON') %>% 
  st_sf %>% 
  mutate(
    unit = row_number()
  )
buff_units <- brittany_only %>% 
  st_join(buff200_units, join = st_intersects)

grouped_buff <- buff_units %>% 
  group_by(unit, zone) %>% 
  summarise() %>% 
  #buffer de 2000m autour de chaque point d'échantillonage REBENT pour definir la taille de chaque site.
  st_join(st_buffer(coord, 1000), join = st_intersects) %>% 
  group_by(site) %>% 
  summarise() %>% 
  na.omit()

(p_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data=brit2 %>% st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON"),
          fill="gray90",
          col = "transparent"
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = grouped_buff %>% st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON"),
          aes(fill = site),
          col = "transparent",
          alpha = .3)+
  geom_sf(data = coord,
          aes(col = site),
          size = 1)+
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE,
           label_axes = list(bottom = "E",
                             right = "N")) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "")+
  scale_y_continuous(name = "")+
  # scale_fill_manual(values = pal)+
  # scale_colour_manual(values = pal)+
  ggspatial::annotation_scale(aes(width_hint = .2, style = "ticks")))

```

# MPB cell count data

```{r}
mpbc_raw <- read.csv("data/mpb_counts.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1 ) 

mpbc_homo <- mpbc_raw %>% 
  rownames_to_column("sp") %>% 
  mutate(sp = case_match(sp,
    "Bacillaria paradoxa" ~ "Bacillaria paxillifera",
    "Licmophora cf. flavellata" ~ "Licmophora cf. flabellata",
    "Campilodiscus sp." ~ "Campylodiscus sp.",
    "Achnantes sp." ~ "Achnanthes sp.",
    "Nitzschioides" ~ "Bacillariaceae",
    "Licmophora cf. flavellata" ~ "Licmophora cf. flabellata",
    "Nitzschia sp." ~ "Nitzschia sp.1",
    "Agregats Nitzschia sp." ~ "Nitzschia sp.2",
    "Entomoneis sp." ~ "Entomoneis sp.1",
    "Entomoneis sp. (petite)" ~ "Entomoneis sp.2",
    "Amphora sp." ~ "Amphora sp.1",
    "Amphora sp. (petite)" ~ "Amphora sp.2",
    "Synedra sp. (courbe)" ~"Synedra sp.",
    "Melosira moniliformis (chaine)" ~ "Melosira moniliformis",
    "Paralia sulcata (chaînes)" ~ "Paralia sulcata",
    "Diatomee pennee 100 µm" ~ "Bacillariophyceae",
     "Naviculoides" ~ "Naviculaceae",
    "Diatomees en gelee" ~ "Bacillariophyta",
    "Rhoicosphaenia sp." ~ "Rhoicosphenia sp.",
    "Toxarium hennedianum" ~ "Toxarium hennedyanum",
    .default = sp)
    ) %>% 
  arrange(sp)
  

mpbc <- as.data.frame(t(mpbc_homo %>% column_to_rownames("sp")))
mpbc[is.na(mpbc)] <-0
rowSums(mpbc)
S <- specnumber(mpbc) # observed number of species
S

mpbc_season <- mpbc %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("code") %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 7 ~ "Spring",
         month > 6 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn")) %>% 
  group_by(site, season) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(code =  paste(site, season, sep = "_")) %>% 
  select(-site, -month, -season) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("code")


mpbc_site <- mpbc %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("code") %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1)) %>% 
  group_by(site) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%  
  column_to_rownames("site")

out <- iNEXT(x = t(mpbc_season), datatype = "abundance")

out_site <- iNEXT(x = t(mpbc_site), datatype = "abundance")

z <- fortify(out, type=1)%>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(Assemblage,1, 1),
         site = case_when(site == "L" ~ "Lomergat",
                           site == "R" ~ "Rozegat"),
         season = str_sub(Assemblage, 3,8))

data.sub <- z[which(z$Method=="Observed"),]

z <- z %>% 
  mutate(Method = case_when(Method == "Observed" ~ "Rarefaction",
                             .default = Method))

ggplot(z, aes(x=x, y=y, colour=season, size = site)) + 
    geom_point(data = data.sub, aes(shape=site), size=5) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype=Method), lwd=1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes_string(ymin="y.lwr", ymax="y.upr", fill="season", colour="NULL"), alpha=0.2)+
  facet_wrap(facets = "site")+
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(2,1))+
  guides(linetype=guide_legend(title=NULL),
           colour=guide_legend(title=NULL), 
           fill=guide_legend(title=NULL)) +
  labs(x ="Number of individuals", y = "Species richness")+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
          legend.title=element_blank(),
          text=element_text(size=18),
          legend.key.width = unit(1.2,"cm"))



ggiNEXT(out_site, type = 1)+
  labs(x ="Number of individuals", y = "Species richness")
```

## PCA

```{r}
is.euclid(dist(mpbc))
is.metric(dist(mpbc))
is.euclid(dist.ldc(mpbc, "hellinger"))
is.metric(dist.ldc(mpbc, "hellinger"))

mpbc_pca <- rda(decostand(mpbc, method = "hellinger"))
screeplot(mpbc_pca, bstick = TRUE)

var_axes <- round(mpbc_pca$CA$eig/sum(mpbc_pca$CA$eig)*100,2)
names(var_axes) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
site_scores <- scores(mpbc_pca, scaling = 1, display = 'sites', choices = c(1:3)) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("code") %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 6 ~ "Spring",
         month > 5 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn"))
site_scores2 <- scores(mpbc_pca, scaling = 2, display = 'sites', choices = c(1:3)) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("code") %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 7 ~ "Spring",
         month > 6 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn"))
sp_scores <- scores(mpbc_pca, scaling = 2, display = 'species', choices = c(1:3))
sp_fit <- goodness(mpbc_pca,model="CA",statistic="explained")
sp_scores <- data.frame(species=rownames(sp_scores),sp_scores, fit1=sp_fit[,1], fit2=sp_fit[,2])
(p1 <- ggplot()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = 2) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype = 2) +
  # ggpubr::stat_chull(
  #   data = site_scores,
  #   mapping = aes(
  #     x = PC1,
  #     y = PC2,
  #     colour = site,
  #     fill = site
  #   ),
  #   geom = "polygon",
  #   alpha = .1,
  #   linewidth = .6
  # )+
  geom_point(data = site_scores,
                       mapping = aes(x = PC1,
                                     y = PC2,
                                     colour = site,
                                     shape = season),
                       alpha = .7,
                       size = 1.5)+
  # coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-.36, .5), ylim = c(-.36, .5), expand = FALSE)+
             theme_light()+
             theme(text = element_text(size = 11),
        aspect.ratio = 1,
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom"
        )+
  xlab(paste(names(var_axes)[1],": ",var_axes[1],"%"))+
               ylab(paste(names(var_axes)[2],": ",var_axes[2],"%"))+
  ggplot()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = 2) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype = 2) +
  geom_point(data = site_scores2,
                       mapping = aes(x = PC1,
                                     y = PC2,
                                     colour = site,
                                     shape = season),
                       alpha = .7,
                       size = 1.5)+
             geom_segment(data = sp_scores %>% filter(fit1 > 0.25 | fit2 > 0.25),
                         aes(x = 0, y = 0,
                             xend = PC1,
                             yend = PC2),
                         colour="gray20")+
             geom_text_repel(data=sp_scores %>% filter(fit1 > 0.25 | fit2 > 0.25),
                             aes(x = PC1,
                                 y= PC2,
                                 label = species),
                            fontface="bold",
                            colour="black",
                            segment.colour="black",
                            max.overlaps = Inf,
                            size = 2
                            )+
  # coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-.75, 1.25), ylim = c(-.75, 1.25), expand = FALSE)+
             theme_light()+
        theme(text = element_text(size = 11),
        aspect.ratio = 1,
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom"
        )+
  xlab(paste(names(var_axes)[1],": ",var_axes[1],"%"))+
               ylab(paste(names(var_axes)[2],": ",var_axes[2],"%"))+
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical"))

ggsave("fig1_PCA_counts.png", p1, height = 150, width = 210, units = "mm")
```

# PCoA with presence/absence data

```{r}

ppcoa <- cmdscale(vegdist(decostand(mpbc, "pa"), method = "jaccard"), eig = TRUE)

var_axes <- round(ppcoa$eig[ppcoa$eig > 0]/sum(ppcoa$eig[ppcoa$eig > 0])*100,2)

pcoaxes <- scores(ppcoa) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("code") %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 7 ~ "Spring",
         month > 6 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn"))
pcoarr <- as.data.frame(scores(envfit(ppcoa, mpbc), "vectors")) %>%
  mutate(r2 = envfit(ppcoa, mpbc)[["vectors"]]$r,
         p = envfit(ppcoa, mpbc)[["vectors"]]$pvals,
         sig = ifelse(p < .05, "significant", "nonsignificant"))
(p_ts <- ggplot() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = 2) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype = 2) + 
  # ggpubr::stat_chull(
  #   data = pcoaxes,
  #   mapping = aes(
  #     x = Dim1,
  #     y = Dim2,
  #   ),
  #   colour = "gray45",
  #   fill = "gray45",
  #   geom = "polygon",
  #   alpha = .1,
  #   linewidth = .6
  # )+
    geom_segment(data = pcoarr ,
               aes(x = 0,
                   y = 0,
                   xend = Dim1,
                   yend = Dim2,
                   linewidth = sqrt(r2)),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.30, "cm")),
               alpha = .5)+
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = pcoarr ,
                           aes(x = Dim1,
                               y = Dim2,
                               label = rownames(pcoarr),
                              size = sqrt(r2)),
                           inherit.aes = FALSE,
                           max.overlaps = Inf)+
  geom_point(
    data = pcoaxes,
    mapping = aes(
      x = Dim1,
      y = Dim2,
      colour = site,
      shape = season
    ),
    alpha = .8
  ) +
  scale_linewidth_continuous(range = c(0.25,1))+
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2.8,4.2))+
  # scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-.9,.9), expand = FALSE)+
  # scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-.9,.9), expand = FALSE)+
  theme_light()+
  labs(x = paste("Dim 1:", var_axes[1], "%", sep = " "),
       y = paste("Dim 2:", var_axes[2], "%", sep = " "))+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 11),
        aspect.ratio = 1,
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom"
        ))
ggsave("fig1_PCoA_pa.png", p_ts, height = 150, width = 210, units = "mm")
```

# Trajectories

```{r}
#| output: false
mpbc_pcoa <- pcoa(dist.ldc(mpbc, "hellinger"), correction="none", rn=NULL)
# Calculate weighted average scores using the species data and PCoA result
weighted_scores <- wascores(mpbc_pcoa$vectors, mpbc)

# Extract the scores for PCoA1 and PCoA2 dimensions
weighted_scores_pcoa <- data.frame(Dim1 =  weighted_scores[,1],
                                   Dim2 =  weighted_scores[,2])


# Select the top contributing species (e.g., top 10)
(top_species <- rownames(weighted_scores_pcoa)[order(weighted_scores_pcoa$Dim1, decreasing = TRUE)][1:9])

meta <- as.data.frame(mpbc) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("code") %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         site = as.factor(ifelse(site == "R","Rozegat", "Lomergat")),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 7 ~ "Spring",
         month > 6 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn"),
         code = paste(site,season)) %>% 
  select(site, month, season,code)

traj <- defineTrajectories(dist.ldc(mpbc, "hellinger"), sites =meta$site, times = meta$month)
trajobj <- trajectoryPCoA(traj,  traj.colors = c("red", "blue"), lwd = 2, 
                      survey.labels = F)
legend("bottomleft", col = c("red", "blue"), legend=levels(meta$site), bty="n", lty=1, lwd = 2)


trajdf <- trajobj$points %>% as.data.frame()%>%
  bind_cols(meta)

```

```{r}
ggplot(trajdf)+
  geom_point(aes(x = V1,
                 y = V2,
                 colour =  site,
                 shape = season),
             size = 1.5) +
  geom_path(aes(x = V1,
                y = V2,
                colour = site,
                linetype = site),
            linewidth = 1,
            arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm"),
                          type = "closed"))+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-.9, .9), ylim = c(-.9, .9))+
  theme_light()+
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

is.synchronous(traj)
```

# Biomass estimation through biovolume

```{r}
bv_raw <- read.csv("data/mpb_bv.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1) 

bv_homo <- bv_raw %>% 
  rownames_to_column("sp") %>% 
  mutate(sp = case_match(sp,
    "Bacillaria paradoxa" ~ "Bacillaria paxillifera",
    "Licmophora cf. flavellata" ~ "Licmophora cf. flabellata",
    "Campilodiscus sp." ~ "Campylodiscus sp.",
    "Achnantes sp." ~ "Achnanthes sp.",
    "Nitzschioides" ~ "Bacillariaceae",
    "Nitzschia sp." ~ "Nitzschia sp.1",
    "Agregats Nitzschia sp." ~ "Nitzschia sp.2",
    "Entomoneis sp." ~ "Entomoneis sp.1",
    "Entomoneis sp. (petite)" ~ "Entomoneis sp.2",
    "Amphora sp." ~ "Amphora sp.1",
    "Amphora sp. (petite)" ~ "Amphora sp.2",
    "Synedra sp. (courbe)" ~"Synedra sp.",
    "Melosira moniliformis (chaine)" ~ "Melosira moniliformis",
    "Paralia sulcata (chaînes)" ~ "Paralia sulcata",
    "Diatomee pennee 100 µm" ~ "Bacillariophyceae",
     "Naviculoides" ~ "Naviculaceae",
    "Diatomees en gelee" ~ "Bacillariophyta",
    "Rhoicosphaenia sp." ~ "Rhoicosphenia sp.",
    "Toxarium hennedianum" ~ "Toxarium hennedyanum",
    .default = sp),
    c_pg = 10^(.76*log10(bv)-.352)) %>% 
  arrange(sp)
mpbc_homo[is.na(mpbc_homo)] <- 0

surf <- (pi*(2.7^2))*10^-4 #m2
vtot <- 0.1 #Litres
vsub <- 0.003 #Litres
mpbc_m2 <- mpbc_homo %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = -sp, .fns = ~ .x * (vtot/vsub) * 1/surf))

mpbb <- mpbc_m2 %>% 
  left_join(bv_homo) %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = R18_02_2021:L27_10_2021, .fns = ~ .x * c_pg * 1e-6)) %>% 
  select(-c_pg, -bv) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sp") %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame()

rowSums(mpbb)


```

```{r}

is.euclid(dist.ldc(mpbb, "hellinger"))

mpbb_pca <- rda(decostand(mpbb, method = "hellinger"))
screeplot(mpbb_pca, bstick = TRUE)

var_axes <- round(mpbb_pca$CA$eig/sum(mpbb_pca$CA$eig)*100,2)
names(var_axes) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
site_scores <- scores(mpbb_pca, scaling = 1, display = 'sites', choices = c(1:3)) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("code") %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 7 ~ "Spring",
         month > 6 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn"))
site_scores2 <- scores(mpbb_pca, scaling = 2, display = 'sites', choices = c(1:3)) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column("code") %>% 
  mutate(site = str_sub(code,1, 1),
         month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 7 ~ "Spring",
         month > 6 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn"))
sp_scores <- scores(mpbb_pca, scaling = 2, display = 'species', choices = c(1:3))
sp_fit <- goodness(mpbb_pca,model="CA",statistic="explained")
sp_scores <- data.frame(species=rownames(sp_scores),sp_scores, fit=sp_fit[,2])
ggplot()+
  geom_point(data = site_scores,
                       mapping = aes(x = PC1,
                                     y = PC2,
                                     colour = season,
                                     shape = site),
                       alpha = .7,
                       size = 1.5)+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-.36, .5), ylim = c(-.36, .5), expand = FALSE)+
             theme_light()+
             theme(aspect.ratio = 1)+
  xlab(paste(names(var_axes)[1],": ",var_axes[1],"%"))+
               ylab(paste(names(var_axes)[2],": ",var_axes[2],"%"))+
  ggplot()+
  geom_point(data = site_scores2,
                       mapping = aes(x = PC1,
                                     y = PC2,
                                     colour = season,
                                     shape = site),
                       alpha = .7,
                       size = 1.5)+
             geom_segment(data = sp_scores[sp_scores$fit > 0.25,],
                         aes(x = 0, y = 0,
                             xend = PC1,
                             yend = PC2),
                         colour="gray20")+
             geom_text_repel(data=sp_scores[sp_scores$fit > 0.25,],
                             aes(x = PC1,
                                 y= PC2,
                                 label = species),
                            fontface="bold",
                            colour="black",
                            segment.colour="black",
                            max.overlaps = Inf
                            )+
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-.75, 1.25), ylim = c(-.75, 1.25), expand = FALSE)+
             theme_light()+
             theme(aspect.ratio = 1)+
  xlab(paste(names(var_axes)[1],": ",var_axes[1],"%"))+
               ylab(paste(names(var_axes)[2],": ",var_axes[2],"%"))+
  plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```

## Total Biomass estimation through BSi:C ratio

```{r}
bsi <- read.csv("data/mpb_bsi.csv", header = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(date, site) %>% 
  summarise(bsi_nmol_g = mean(bsi_nmol_g)) %>% 
  mutate(maerl_m2 = ifelse(site == "Lomergat", 2572.8, 1989.5), #g/m2
         bsi_mol_m2 = bsi_nmol_g * 1e-9* maerl_m2,
         c_ug_m2 = (bsi_mol_m2/.12)*12.011*1e6, # (bSi(mol/m2) / ratio BSi:C) * masse molaire C (g)*1e6 (ug) 
         code = paste(str_sub(site, 1,1), date, sep = ""))
mpb_carbon <- data.frame(code = rownames(mpbb), bv_c = rowSums(mpbb)) %>% 
  left_join(bsi) %>% 
  rename(bsi_c = c_ug_m2) %>% 
  mutate(month = as.numeric(str_sub(code, 5,6)),
         season = case_when(month < 3 ~ "Winter",
                            month >= 3 & month < 7 ~ "Spring",
         month > 6 & month < 9 ~ "Summer",
         month >= 9 ~ "Autumn"))

(p_c <- ggplot(data = mpb_carbon, aes(x = bsi_c*1e-3, y = bv_c*1e-3))+
  geom_point(aes(colour =site, shape = season))+
  geom_smooth(aes(colour =site), method = "lm", se = F)+
  labs(x = "BSi:C estimated C (mg • m-2)",
       y = "Biovolume estimated C (mg • m-2)"))
ggsave("fig3_biomasse.png", p_c, height = 150, width = 210, units = "mm")
mpb_carbon %>%
  group_by(site) %>% 
  summarise(bsi_c_mean = mean(bsi_c*1e-3),
            bsi_c_se = sd(bsi_c*1e-3)/(sqrt(nrow(.)/2)),
            bv_c_mean = mean(bv_c*1e-3),
            bv_c_se = sd(bv_c*1e-3)/(sqrt(nrow(.)))/2) %>%  ungroup()

ggplot(data = mpb_carbon %>% mutate(date = as.Date(date, "%d_%m_%y")), aes(x = date, y = bv_c*1e-3))+
  geom_point(aes(colour =site))+
  geom_line(aes(colour =site, group = site))+
  labs(x = "Month",
       y = "Biovolume estimated C (mg • m-2)")+
  scale_y_log10()+
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month")
ggsave("fig3_biomasse.png", p_c, height = 150, width = 210, units = "mm")

```

## Traits

```{r}
traits_uk <- read.csv2("data/Phytoplankton__Progetto_Strategico_2009_2012_United_Kingdom.csv")%>% 
  select(class:genus, scientificName, shape)
traits_med <- read.csv2("data/PhytoplanktonTraits_Mediterranean_BlackSea_CoastalLagoons_v1.2.csv") %>% 
  select(class, family, order, genus, scientificName, shape) %>% 
  mutate(shape = tolower(shape))
traits_bs <- read.csv("data/Phytoplankton__Progetto_Strategico_2009_2012_Turkey.csv",dec = ".",sep = ";") %>% 
  select(class:genus, scientificName, shape)
traits_au <- read.csv("data/Phytoplankton__Progetto_Strategico_2009_2012_Australia.csv",dec = ".",sep = ";") %>% 
  select(class:genus, scientificName, shape)
traits_br <- read.csv2("data/Phytoplankton__Progetto_Strategico_2009_2012_Brasil.csv") %>% 
  select(class:genus, scientificName, shape)
traits_mv <- read.csv2("data/Phytoplankton_Progetto_Strategico_2009_2012_Maldives.csv")%>% 
  select(class:genus, scientificName, shape)
taxo <- bv_homo %>% 
  mutate(scientificName = ifelse(str_detect(sp, "sp"),
                                 str_split_i(string = sp, pattern = " ", i = 1),
                                 sp),
         scientificName = str_remove(scientificName, "cf. "),
         genus = str_split_i(string = scientificName, pattern = " ", i = 1)) %>% 
  filter(sp != "Bacillariophyceae")

tt <- traits_uk %>%
  bind_rows(traits_med) %>%
  bind_rows(traits_br) %>% 
  bind_rows(traits_bs) %>%
  bind_rows(traits_au) %>% 
  bind_rows(traits_mv) %>%
  filter(scientificName %in% taxo$scientificName | scientificName %in% taxo$genus ) %>% 
  distinct(pick(scientificName, shape), .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  select(scientificName, shape, everything())
  
traits <- taxo %>% 
  left_join(tt) %>%
  select(sp, shape, everything())

write.csv(traits %>% select(sp, bv, shape), "data/shapes.csv")

test <- worms_id(taxo)
test_classif <- worms_classif(test, taxo)
```
